title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to quickly jump/navigate to the First or Last row in the list
summary: The post explains how to use keyboard shortcuts to quickly navigate to the first or last row in Business Central lists without customization. Ctrl+Home jumps to the first row and Ctrl+End jumps to the last row, saving time when working with large datasets.
key_points: Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End shortcuts navigate to first and last rows respectively
On macOS, use Fn+Ctrl+Left arrow for first row and Fn+Ctrl+Right arrow for last row
These shortcuts work in list views, tile views, and subforms like Sales Order Subform
No page customization is needed to use these built-in keyboard shortcuts

quotes.text: a simple keyboard shortcut gets the job done
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights that built-in shortcuts eliminate the need for custom action buttons

quotes.text: This also works in pages such as Sales Order Subform.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the shortcuts are not limited to list pages but work across different page types
